title: SpaceNet AOI_2_Vegas WorldView-3 PAN + 8-band MS source tiles (R1C1) with DG XML/RPB
licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (The SpaceNet Dataset by SpaceNet Partners, https://spacenet.ai/off-nadir-building-detection/ )
attribution: The SpaceNet Dataset by SpaceNet Partners (imagery (c) Maxar/DigitalGlobe), licensed CC BY-SA 4.0
format: GeoTIFF (DigitalGlobe LV2A Standard tile) + DG XML
profile: WV03, PAN 16-bit 16384x16384 (~0.31 m), MS 8-band 16-bit (~1.24 m), RPC00B in XML <RPB> block, off-nadir 16.8, 0% cloud, 2015-10-22
notes: TIFFs carry NO RPC tag (checked: IFD at end of file, no tag 50844, not COG). RPCs are in the product-level DG .XML (<RPB>, SPECID RPC00B); the XMLs are renamed locally to the tile basename so GDAL's DigitalGlobe metadata reader pairs them. R1C1 is the top-left tile, so the product RPC applies without tile offset (check the TIL if other tiles are added). Product is LV2A 'Standard' (map-projected, coarse DEM) - RPC is usable for sensor-model tests but the image is not raw 1B geometry; use the Atlanta L1B item for true sensor geometry.

title: SpaceNet Off-Nadir Atlanta WorldView-2 Level-1B PAN/MUL strips with RPB, ATT/EPH/GEO (two same-pass looks)
licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (The SpaceNet Dataset by SpaceNet Partners, https://spacenet.ai/off-nadir-building-detection/ )
attribution: The SpaceNet Dataset by SpaceNet Partners (imagery (c) Maxar/DigitalGlobe), licensed CC BY-SA 4.0
profile: WV02 LV1B 16-bit; PAN + 8-band MUL; RPC00B (.RPB); off-nadir 52.5 / 53.7 deg, 2009-12-22, 0% cloud
notes: True raw sensor-geometry (1B) product with full physical-model support files (attitude .ATT, ephemeris .EPH, camera .GEO) and RPC (.RPB) - ideal for sensor-model/RPC tests. Keep each look's files together in its own folder with original basenames (GDAL pairs .TIF with same-basename .RPB/.IMD/.XML). The two PAN looks (catids 1030010003BDDC00 and 1030010003CD4300) overlap almost completely (~33.8-34.07N, -84.6..-84.18) but are from the same pass with similar azimuth (~199) and off-nadir (~52-54), so the stereo convergence angle is small - suitable for multi-image RPC/tie-point tests, weak for DSM. Other catids in AOIs/AOI_6_Atlanta/metadata/ (27 looks, off-nadir 7-54) can be added for larger-baseline stereo (segments 0.5-1.9 GB each).
